steelman: A senior infrastructure practitioner might note that office desk rearrangements often involve moving physical networking equipment — access points, edge switches, or patch-panel connections — which can disrupt local LAN or on-prem gateway connectivity. If the team ran an on-prem reverse proxy or VPN gateway through which webhook traffic was tunnelled, a physical relocation during the desk rearrangement could plausibly interrupt that path and cause intermittent delivery failures. The tight temporal coincidence combined with a credible institutional observer (office manager, six years tenure) could make this hypothesis feel worth investigating on an initial triage checklist.
notes: xbase explicitly states the endpoint is 'deployed on a major cloud platform — not our office network,' which directly forecloses the only defensible mechanism (an on-prem intermediary in the delivery path). The delivery path is SaaS provider cloud to cloud-hosted endpoint with no office-local segment. The HTTP 401 errors further confirm a server-side authentication failure (mismatched webhook signing secret) with no physical causal pathway. No repair needed; seed passes this lens.
